promotions.body:
## Cadance 6
- Teacher Notebook for typed and handwritten class notes
- Track links you can save in a note and play later
- Focus Player precision scrubbing for accurate cue placement
- Improved Apple Music, Bluetooth, AirPlay, and Apple Watch reliability

Open the Visual Tour in Favorites for a guide to the new tools.
promotions.headline: What's new in Cadance 6

promotions.body:
## Perfect Practice Pass
Choose one eligible track to unlock for 30 days. It is ideal for an exercise you return to again and again.

## Separate from Day Passes
A Day Pass unlocks Cadance for the teaching day. A Perfect Practice Pass unlocks one selected track for 30 days.

Find Perfect Practice Passes in Settings, Account & Subscription, or an eligible track's action menu.
promotions.headline: Practice one track for 30 days

promotions.body:
## Teach today with a Day Pass
In Class Planning mode, every track starts with a 15-second planning preview. When it is time to teach, activate a Day Pass for full access until midnight.

You can activate a Day Pass from Settings > Day Passes while Preview Mode is active, or from an eligible track's action menu. Day Passes never expire, so you can use them only on the days you teach.
promotions.headline: Teach today with a Pass
